title: Red Earth — Gate 2.5 Starter Shiny Contract
author: Adam M. Aguilera
summary: Gate 2.5 replacement built cleanly from accepted 0.2.4 and published as 0.2.6 so existing failed 0.2.5 installs receive an update. Makes Oak-gift Fennekin and approved Grass starters genuine shinies, preserves shiny identity through evolution/save, and routes dedicated shiny battle plus party/menu art through native render paths. Does not alter Irregular art, battle scale/grounding, starter selection, followers, sparkle/audio, Nature, or passives.
